The ''''Wumbus'''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be won in the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|summer}}, when the movie "Wumbus" is playing in the Movie Theater.

This poster is displayed outside the [[Movie Theater]] while the movie is playing, and the season before it's featured.

==Trivia==
*In 2011, [[ConcernedApe]] created a series of comics called [http://wumbusworld.com/index.php?strip=1 Wumbus World].
